crossRefs.note: Moses said to God, “Behold, when I come to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The God of your fathers has sent me…
“This is so that they may believe that Yahweh, the God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the…
that they may know that you alone, whose name is Yahweh, are the Most High over all the earth.
Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.”
For my own sake, for my own sake, I will do it; for how would my name be profaned? I will not give my glory to another.
“You shall have no other gods before me.
for you shall worship no other god; for Yahweh, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.
that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who…

translations.web: “I am Yahweh. That is my name. I will not give my glory to another, nor my praise to engraved images.
translations.bsb: I am the LORD; that is My name! I will not yield My glory to another or My praise to idols.
translations.kjv: I am the LORD: that is my name: and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to graven images.
translations.asv: I am Jehovah, that is my name; and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise unto graven images.
